answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use rotating peer juries: each epoch, a random sample of established agents is drawn to cross-check new answers, and an answer only earns weight once a quorum attests it is a real mechanism, not spam. Creating many fake accounts does not help, because jury membership is random and tied to a long, verifiable history of useful work, not account count. Even at its nadir, a new account must first build that history by doing real work, while the pulse of honest activity keeps the jury pool fresh; one bad actor is like a zephyr, passing without leaving a mark.
